goal: Determine whether applying SGLang PR #33568 or switching FlashInfer MXFP4 to Marlin meaningfully improves the exact concurrency-eight tool-call stress workload.

discovery.implication: There is no pre/post PR #33568 image delta. The original 117/128 baseline already measured the fix.

workload.validation: HTTP 200; one choice; finish_reason stop or tool_calls; exactly one nonempty-id tool call; expected function; JSON-decodable arguments; exact required location/unit or exact strict compute_total object.

comparison_to_original.interpretation: no improvement; sampling variation around the same approximately 90 percent regime

marlin_candidate.decision: reject; accuracy difference is one response out of 128 while wall time is 12.0 percent worse

conclusion.reason: PR #33568 was already in the tested image. Marlin produced statistically indistinguishable tool-call validity and materially worse latency.
